criteria.description: Environment ready: stripe mock reachable and state loaded.
B-4412 proportional credit computed from the actual defect count (115/500 = 23%, $1,955), not the report's stated 25% ($2,125).

Every required refund issued at the correct per-policy amount: partials (Bluetooth, corrugated mailers, freight SLA, warehousing overcharge), full refunds (retail box print, duplicate gift-box insert, fabric sample set).
No refund issued on QA-passed / within-tolerance / out-of-scope charges (USB-C cable, organic cotton bolt, LED driver board within 1% tolerance, platform access fee).
Batch tracking customer 'Refund Batch 2026-06' created with correct total_refunded_cents, refund_count, customers_affected, and batch_date metadata.
Net refund-liability payment intent created with the correct amount and batch/type metadata.
Each credited supplier's account description rolled up with refunded amount, transaction count, and the 2026-06 batch tag.
